38 hundredths is less than 40 or 41 hundredths.
0.09 is only 9 hundredths.

stem.en: Match each pair of decimals to the correct comparison symbol.
stem.es: Relaciona cada par de decimales con el símbolo de comparación correcto.

hints.en: Write each pair with the same number of decimal places.
Compare the hundredths.

solution.es: Con el mismo número de lugares decimales se compara fácilmente.

objective: Explain why adding a zero at the end of a decimal to hundredths keeps the same value.

stem.en: Explain why 0.3 and 0.30 are the same amount.
stem.es: Explica por qué 0.3 y 0.30 son la misma cantidad.

criteria.en: Says 3 tenths and 30 hundredths cover the same part of a grid
criteria.es: Dice que 3 décimos y 30 centésimos cubren la misma parte de una cuadrícula

sample.en: 0.3 is 3/10. Cutting each tenth into 10 hundredths gives 30/100, which is 0.30. On a 100-square grid, 3 columns and 30 squares cover the same area.
sample.es: 0.3 es 3/10. Al cortar cada décimo en 10 centésimos se obtiene 30/100, que es 0.30. En una cuadrícula de 100 cuadros, 3 columnas y 30 cuadros cubren la misma área.

hints.en: Write each decimal as a fraction.
How many hundredths are in one tenth?
Shade 3 columns of a 100-square grid and count squares.

objective: Write a decimal as a number of hundredths.

stem.en: A flag has 100 equal squares. The decimal 0.38 of the squares are blue. How many squares are blue?
stem.es: Una bandera tiene 100 cuadros iguales. El decimal 0.38 de los cuadros son azules. ¿Cuántos cuadros son azules?

hints.en: 0.38 is the same as a fraction with denominator 100.
Read the digits after the decimal point as the numerator.
Think of 38 hundredths.

objective: Match decimals to fractions with denominators 10 or 100.

stem.en: Match each decimal to the fraction that names it.
stem.es: Relaciona cada decimal con la fracción que lo nombra.

hints.en: One decimal place means tenths; two places mean hundredths.
0.09 has a zero in the tenths place.
Read the digits as the numerator.

solution.es: Un lugar decimal son décimos; dos lugares son centésimos.

objective: Use a decimal grid to show a decimal as hundredths.

stem.en: The grid has 100 squares. Shade squares to show 0.34.
stem.es: La cuadrícula tiene 100 cuadros. Sombrea cuadros para mostrar 0.34.

hints.en: 0.34 is 34 hundredths.
One whole grid has 100 squares.
How many squares equal 34 hundredths?

objective: Justify a decimal comparison using a hundredths grid.

stem.en: Use a 100-square grid or place value to explain why 0.4 is greater than 0.39.
stem.es: Usa una cuadrícula de 100 cuadros o el valor posicional para explicar por qué 0.4 es mayor que 0.39.

sample.en: 0.4 = 0.40 is 40 hundredths. 0.39 is 39 hundredths. 40 hundredths is 1 hundredth more than 39 hundredths, so 0.4 > 0.39.
sample.es: 0.4 = 0.40 son 40 centésimos. 0.39 son 39 centésimos. 40 centésimos es 1 centésimo más que 39 centésimos, así que 0.4 > 0.39.

hints.en: Shade 4 columns of a 100-grid, then 39 squares.
Write 0.4 using hundredths.
Compare 40 and 39.

objective: Sort decimals by comparing them with 0.5.

stem.en: Sort each decimal as less than 0.5 or greater than 0.5.
stem.es: Clasifica cada decimal como menor que 0.5 o mayor que 0.5.

hints.en: 0.5 is the same as 0.50.
Compare tenths first.
If the tenths match, compare hundredths.

solution.es: Compara con 0.50 usando décimos y centésimos.

objective: Compare two decimals in a measurement context and find the difference.

stem.en: Pia jumped 1.35 meters in the long jump. Quin jumped 1.4 meters. How many meters farther did Quin jump?
stem.es: Pia saltó 1.35 metros en salto largo. Quin saltó 1.4 metros. ¿Cuántos metros más lejos saltó Quin?

sample.en: 1.4 = 1.40. 1.40 − 1.35 = 0.05 meter, so Quin jumped 0.05 meter farther.
sample.es: 1.4 = 1.40. 1.40 − 1.35 = 0.05 metro, así que Quin saltó 0.05 metro más lejos.

hints.en: Write both lengths with two decimal places.
Which is greater, 1.40 or 1.35?
Subtract the smaller from the greater.

objective: Write money as a decimal part of a dollar.

stem.en: Theo has 3 dimes and 5 pennies. A dime is 0.1 dollar and a penny is 0.01 dollar. How many dollars does Theo have?
stem.es: Theo tiene 3 monedas de diez centavos y 5 centavos. Una moneda de diez centavos es 0.1 dólar y un centavo es 0.01 dólar. ¿Cuántos dólares tiene Theo?

choices.why: This adds 3 + 5 as tenths. The pennies are hundredths.
3 dimes are less than one dollar.
The digits are in the wrong places.

hints.en: 3 dimes is 3 tenths of a dollar.
5 pennies is 5 hundredths.
Write tenths in the first place and hundredths in the second.

solution.es: 3 monedas de diez centavos = 0.30 y 5 centavos = 0.05; en total 0.35 dólares.

objective: Locate a decimal to hundredths on a number line.

stem.en: A number line from 0 to 1 is marked every 0.05. Mark the decimal 0.75.
stem.es: Una recta numérica de 0 a 1 está marcada cada 0.05. Marca el decimal 0.75.

hints.en: 0.75 is 75 hundredths.
Count by 0.05 or find the halfway marks first.
0.50 and 0.75 are quarters.

steps: The point sits at the 15th mark from 0.
solution.es: 0.75 está a la mitad entre 0.50 y 1.00.

objective: Locate a decimal on a number line divided into tenths.

stem.en: The number line from 0 to 1 is cut into 10 equal parts. Mark 0.6.
stem.es: La recta numérica de 0 a 1 está dividida en 10 partes iguales. Marca 0.6.

hints.en: Each part is one tenth.
0.6 is six tenths.
Count 6 parts from 0.

solution.es: Cada parte es 0.1; el punto está en la sexta marca: 0.6.

stem.en: Which decimal is the same as 7/100?
stem.es: ¿Qué decimal es igual a 7/100?

7.0 is 7 wholes.
0.007 is 7 thousandths. Hundredths use two places.

hints.en: Hundredths use two places after the decimal point.
Write the 7 in the second place.
Put a zero in the tenths place.

objective: Sort decimals by whether they name tenths or hundredths.

stem.en: Sort each decimal by its smallest place value.
stem.es: Clasifica cada decimal según su lugar de menor valor.

hints.en: Count the digits after the decimal point.
One digit means tenths.
Two digits means hundredths.

solution.es: Un dígito decimal son décimos; dos dígitos son centésimos.

objective: Find the error when writing hundredths as a decimal.

stem.en: Cam wrote 6/100 as a decimal. Which step has the mistake?
stem.es: Cam escribió 6/100 como decimal. ¿Qué paso tiene el error?

hints.en: Where is the 6 if there are two places?
0.6 means 6 tenths.
Put a zero in the tenths place.

steps: 0.6 = 6/10, which is ten times as much.
Hundredths use two places after the decimal point.

objective: Recognize different names for the same decimal or fraction.

stem.en: Select ALL the choices that are equal to 3/10.
stem.es: Selecciona TODAS las opciones que son iguales a 3/10.

choices.why: 0.03 is 3 hundredths, ten times smaller.
0.33 is 33 hundredths.

hints.en: 3/10 means 3 tenths.
Rewrite 3/10 in hundredths.
Compare the number of tenths in each choice.

objective: Find an unknown angle when one part is a multiple of the other.

stem.en: A 120° angle is split into two smaller angles by one ray. The larger angle is twice as big as the smaller angle. What is the measure of the larger angle in degrees?
stem.es: Un ángulo de 120° se divide en dos ángulos menores con un rayo. El ángulo mayor es el doble del ángulo menor. ¿Cuánto mide el ángulo mayor en grados?

criteria.en: Models the angles as 3 equal parts of 120°
criteria.es: Modela los ángulos como 3 partes iguales de 120°

sample.en: The smaller angle is 1 part and the larger is 2 parts, so there are 3 equal parts. 120° ÷ 3 = 40°. The larger angle is 2 × 40° = 80°.
sample.es: El ángulo menor es 1 parte y el mayor son 2 partes, así que hay 3 partes iguales. 120° ÷ 3 = 40°. El ángulo mayor es 2 × 40° = 80°.

hints.en: Draw a tape: 1 part for the smaller angle and 2 parts for the larger.
How many equal parts are there in all?
Divide 120° by the number of parts.

solution.es: El ángulo menor mide 40° y el mayor mide 80°.

objective: Add mixed numbers and fractions and subtract from a capacity.

stem.en: A recipe uses 1 1/4 cups of flour and 3/4 cup of sugar in a 3-cup mixing bowl. How many cups of space are left in the bowl?
stem.es: Una receta usa 1 1/4 tazas de harina y 3/4 de taza de azúcar en un tazón mezclador de 3 tazas. ¿Cuántas tazas de espacio quedan en el tazón?

sample.en: 1 1/4 + 3/4 = 1 + 4/4 = 2 cups. 3 − 2 = 1 cup of space is left.
sample.es: 1 1/4 + 3/4 = 1 + 4/4 = 2 tazas. 3 − 2 = 1 taza de espacio.

hints.en: Find the total in the bowl first.
Add the fractions: 1/4 + 3/4.
Subtract the total from the bowl size.

objective: Solve a multistep problem where division with a remainder changes a cost.

stem.en: A school trip has 247 students. Each bus seats 48 students and costs $120 to rent. What is the total cost, in dollars, to give every student a seat?
stem.es: Una excursión escolar tiene 247 estudiantes. Cada autobús tiene 48 asientos y cuesta $120 de alquiler. ¿Cuál es el costo total, en dólares, para que cada estudiante tenga asiento?

sample.en: 5 buses seat 240 students, so 7 students are left and a 6th bus is needed. 6 × 120 = 720 dollars.
sample.es: 5 autobuses llevan 240 estudiantes, así que sobran 7 y se necesita un 6.º autobús. 6 × 120 = 720 dólares.

hints.en: Find how many buses are needed first.
Divide and look at the remainder.
Leftover students still need a bus.

objective: Add durations given in hours and minutes in a multistep context.

stem.en: Rae rode a bus for 1 hour 50 minutes and then walked for 25 minutes. How many minutes after she left home did she arrive?
stem.es: Rae viajó en autobús durante 1 hora 50 minutos y luego caminó durante 25 minutos. ¿Cuántos minutos después de salir de su casa llegó?

sample.en: 1 hour 50 minutes = 110 minutes. 110 + 25 = 135 minutes.
sample.es: 1 hora 50 minutos = 110 minutos. 110 + 25 = 135 minutos.

hints.en: Use one unit for all the times.
1 hour is 60 minutes.
Add the bus time and the walk time.

objective: Use a model to critique a comparison made from denominators alone.

stem.en: Zed says 1/8 is greater than 1/4 because 8 is greater than 4. Use a bar or number line to explain why he is wrong.
stem.es: Zed dice que 1/8 es mayor que 1/4 porque 8 es mayor que 4. Usa una barra o una recta numérica para explicar por qué se equivoca.

criteria.en: Says eighths are smaller pieces than fourths
criteria.es: Dice que los octavos son piezas más pequeñas que los cuartos

sample.en: Cutting a whole into 8 equal parts makes smaller pieces than cutting it into 4. 1/4 = 2/8, which is 2 eighths, so 1/4 is greater than 1/8.
sample.es: Cortar un entero en 8 partes iguales da piezas más pequeñas que cortarlo en 4. 1/4 = 2/8, que son 2 octavos, así que 1/4 es mayor que 1/8.

hints.en: Draw two bars of the same length, one cut into 4 parts and one into 8.
Compare the size of one piece in each bar.
How many eighths equal one fourth?

objective: List all the factor pairs of a number and justify that the list is complete.

stem.en: List all the factor pairs of 40. Explain how you know you found every pair.
stem.es: Escribe todos los pares de factores de 40. Explica cómo sabes que encontraste todos los pares.

criteria.en: Explains testing 1, 2, 3, ... until the factors meet
criteria.es: Explica que probó 1, 2, 3, ... hasta que los factores se encuentran

sample.en: 1 × 40, 2 × 20, 4 × 10 and 5 × 8. I tested 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 in order. 3, 6 and 7 do not divide 40, and after 5 × 8 the factors start to repeat.
sample.es: 1 × 40, 2 × 20, 4 × 10 y 5 × 8. Probé 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 y 7 en orden. 3, 6 y 7 no dividen 40, y después de 5 × 8 los factores se repiten.

hints.en: Start with 1 and go up in order.
Stop when the smaller factor is bigger than the larger one.
Check each pair by multiplying.

solution.es: Los pares de factores de 40 son 1 × 40, 2 × 20, 4 × 10 y 5 × 8.

objective: Investigate rectangles with a fixed perimeter to find the greatest area.

stem.en: A gardener has 24 feet of fence for a rectangular garden. List the whole-number lengths and widths she could use, find the area of each, and tell which garden has the greatest area.
stem.es: Una jardinera tiene 24 pies de cerca para un jardín rectangular. Escribe los largos y anchos enteros que puede usar, halla el área de cada uno e indica cuál jardín tiene la mayor área.

criteria.en: Concludes 6 by 6 has the greatest area, 36 square feet
criteria.es: Concluye que 6 por 6 tiene la mayor área, 36 pies cuadrados

sample.en: Length + width = 24 ÷ 2 = 12. The gardens are 1 by 11 (11), 2 by 10 (20), 3 by 9 (27), 4 by 8 (32), 5 by 7 (35) and 6 by 6 (36 square feet). The 6 by 6 square garden has the greatest area.
sample.es: Largo + ancho = 24 ÷ 2 = 12. Los jardines son 1 por 11 (11), 2 por 10 (20), 3 por 9 (27), 4 por 8 (32), 5 por 7 (35) y 6 por 6 (36 pies cuadrados). El jardín cuadrado de 6 por 6 tiene la mayor área.

hints.en: The fence is the perimeter, so find half of it.
Length + width is half the perimeter.
Make a table of lengths, widths and areas.

solution.es: El jardín de 6 por 6 tiene el área mayor, 36 pies cuadrados.

objective: Refute a comparison of decimals that uses the number of digits.

stem.en: Jo says 0.50 is greater than 0.5 because 50 is greater than 5. Is Jo right? Explain.
stem.es: Jo dice que 0.50 es mayor que 0.5 porque 50 es mayor que 5. ¿Tiene razón Jo? Explica.

criteria.en: Says Jo is not right; they are equal
criteria.es: Dice que Jo no tiene razón; son iguales

criteria.en: Explains a trailing zero does not change the value
criteria.es: Explica que un cero al final no cambia el valor

sample.en: 0.5 is 5 tenths. Each tenth is 10 hundredths, so 5 tenths is 50 hundredths. 0.5 = 0.50, so Jo is not right.
sample.es: 0.5 son 5 décimos. Cada décimo son 10 centésimos, así que 5 décimos son 50 centésimos. 0.5 = 0.50, así que Jo no tiene razón.

hints.en: Write each decimal as a fraction.
Compare 5/10 and 50/100.
What does adding a zero at the end do to the place values?

objective: Show that an area model and an algorithm give the same product.

stem.en: Find 23 × 14 with an area model that has four parts. Then explain how the four parts match the steps of the standard algorithm.
stem.es: Halla 23 × 14 con un modelo de área de cuatro partes. Luego explica cómo las cuatro partes coinciden con los pasos del algoritmo estándar.

criteria.en: Connects 80 + 12 and 200 + 30 to the two rows of the algorithm
criteria.es: Relaciona 80 + 12 y 200 + 30 con las dos filas del algoritmo

hints.en: Split 23 into 20 + 3 and 14 into 10 + 4.
Find the four partial products.
The algorithm rows add some of these partial products.

steps: The rows 92 and 230 are sums of the parts and also total 322.
solution.es: El modelo de área y el algoritmo dan 322.

objective: Explain why converting to a smaller unit uses multiplication and to a larger unit uses division.

stem.en: Explain why you multiply to change 3 meters to centimeters but divide to change 300 centimeters to meters.
stem.es: Explica por qué se multiplica para cambiar 3 metros a centímetros pero se divide para cambiar 300 centímetros a metros.

criteria.en: Says a centimeter is smaller than a meter so you need more of them
criteria.es: Dice que un centímetro es menor que un metro, así que se necesitan más

sample.en: A centimeter is a smaller unit, so it takes more centimeters than meters to measure the same length: 3 × 100 = 300. Going back, every 100 centimeters make one meter, so 300 ÷ 100 = 3.
sample.es: Un centímetro es una unidad más pequeña, por eso se necesitan más centímetros que metros para medir la misma longitud: 3 × 100 = 300. Al volver, cada 100 centímetros forman un metro, así que 300 ÷ 100 = 3.

hints.en: Compare the size of the two units.
Will the number get bigger or smaller when you use the smaller unit?
How many centimeters make one meter?

objective: Order decimals and justify the order with place value.

stem.en: Put these decimals in order from least to greatest and explain how you decided: 0.62, 0.6, 0.26, 0.06.
stem.es: Ordena estos decimales de menor a mayor y explica cómo decidiste: 0.62, 0.6, 0.26, 0.06.

sample.en: Write them with two places: 0.62, 0.60, 0.26, 0.06. Compare tenths first: 0 tenths, 2 tenths, 6 tenths and 6 tenths. The two with 6 tenths are tied, so compare hundredths: 0.60 < 0.62. Order: 0.06, 0.26, 0.6, 0.62.
sample.es: Escríbelos con dos lugares: 0.62, 0.60, 0.26, 0.06. Compara los décimos primero: 0, 2, 6 y 6 décimos. Los dos con 6 décimos empatan, así que compara centésimos: 0.60 < 0.62. Orden: 0.06, 0.26, 0.6, 0.62.

hints.en: Write every decimal with hundredths.
Compare the tenths digit first.
Break ties with the hundredths digit.

objective: Explain that the size of an angle does not depend on the lengths of its rays.

stem.en: Sam draws an angle with long rays and Tia draws an angle with short rays. Both angles open the same amount. Sam says his angle is bigger. Explain who is right.
stem.es: Sam dibuja un ángulo con rayos largos y Tia dibuja un ángulo con rayos cortos. Ambos ángulos se abren lo mismo. Sam dice que su ángulo es mayor. Explica quién tiene razón.

criteria.en: Says an angle measures how far the rays open (the turn)
criteria.es: Dice que un ángulo mide cuánto se abren los rayos (el giro)

criteria.en: Says longer rays do not change the measure
criteria.es: Dice que rayos más largos no cambian la medida
Concluye que los ángulos son iguales

sample.en: An angle measures how much one ray turns away from the other, not how long the rays are. Rays go on forever, so drawing them longer does not change the angle. The angles are equal.
sample.es: Un ángulo mide cuánto gira un rayo respecto del otro, no qué tan largos son los rayos. Los rayos continúan para siempre, así que dibujarlos más largos no cambia el ángulo. Los ángulos son iguales.

hints.en: What does an angle measure?
Do rays have a fixed length?
Compare the amount of turn.

steps: An angle is measured by the turn between the rays.
solution.es: La medida del ángulo es el giro entre los rayos, no su longitud.

verify.note: Explaining that angle size is independent of ray length is a concept judgment needing teacher review.

objective: Find the range of numbers that round to a given value.

stem.en: A news story says that about 50,000 people came to a concert, rounded to the nearest ten thousand. What are the least and greatest whole-number attendances that could have been rounded to 50,000?
stem.es: Una noticia dice que fueron aproximadamente 50,000 personas a un concierto, redondeado a la decena de millar más cercana. ¿Cuáles son la menor y la mayor asistencia entera que pudo haberse redondeado a 50,000?

criteria.en: Justifies with the rounding rule on the thousands digit
criteria.es: Justifica con la regla de redondeo en el dígito de los millares

sample.en: 45,000 rounds up to 50,000 because its thousands digit is 5, and 44,999 rounds down to 40,000. 54,999 rounds down to 50,000, and 55,000 rounds up to 60,000. So the range is 45,000 to 54,999.
sample.es: 45,000 se redondea hacia arriba a 50,000 porque su dígito de los millares es 5, y 44,999 se redondea hacia abajo a 40,000. 54,999 se redondea a 50,000 y 55,000 se redondea hacia arriba a 60,000. Así que el rango va de 45,000 a 54,999.

hints.en: Find the nearest ten thousands below and above 50,000.
Halfway between 40,000 and 50,000 is 45,000.
Halfway between 50,000 and 60,000 is 55,000.

objective: Construct a number that satisfies a place value relationship.

stem.en: Write a number that has two 7s, where the value of one 7 is 100 times the value of the other 7. Explain how you know.
stem.es: Escribe un número que tenga dos 7, donde el valor de un 7 sea 100 veces el valor del otro 7. Explica cómo lo sabes.

criteria.en: Writes a valid number such as 7,070

sample.en: 7,070 has a 7 in the thousands place worth 7,000 and a 7 in the tens place worth 70. 7,000 ÷ 70 = 100, so the first 7 is worth 100 times the second.
sample.es: 7,070 tiene un 7 en el lugar de los millares que vale 7,000 y un 7 en el lugar de las decenas que vale 70. 7,000 ÷ 70 = 100, así que el primer 7 vale 100 veces el segundo.

hints.en: 100 times means two places to the left.
Pick the places first, then put 7s there.
Fill empty places with zeros.

steps: Thousands and tens are two places apart.
solution.es: 7,070: el 7 de los millares vale 7,000 y el de las decenas vale 70.

objective: Write a story problem for a two-operation expression and solve it.

stem.en: Write a story problem that can be solved with 3 × 15 + 8. Then solve your problem and say what your answer means.
stem.es: Escribe un problema de enunciado que se pueda resolver con 3 × 15 + 8. Luego resuélvelo y di qué significa tu respuesta.

criteria.en: Story uses 3 equal groups of 15 and 8 more
criteria.es: El problema usa 3 grupos iguales de 15 y 8 más

criteria.en: States 53 with a unit that matches the story
criteria.es: Indica 53 con una unidad que coincide con el problema

sample.en: A shop has 3 shelves with 15 books on each shelf and 8 more books on a table. 3 × 15 = 45 and 45 + 8 = 53 books in all.
sample.es: Una tienda tiene 3 estantes con 15 libros en cada uno y 8 libros más en una mesa. 3 × 15 = 45 y 45 + 8 = 53 libros en total.

hints.en: Think of 3 equal groups with 15 in each group.
What could the extra 8 be?
Make sure the story says what 53 counts.

solution.es: 3 × 15 + 8 = 53 con una historia que tenga 3 grupos iguales y 8 más.

objective: Write a story problem for a whole number times a fraction and solve it.

stem.en: Write a story problem for 4 × 3/8. Solve it, and write the answer as a mixed number.
stem.es: Escribe un problema de enunciado para 4 × 3/8. Resuélvelo y escribe la respuesta como un número mixto.

criteria.es: El problema tiene 4 grupos iguales de 3/8

sample.en: Each of 4 plants needs 3/8 gallon of water. 4 × 3/8 = 12/8 = 1 4/8 = 1 1/2 gallons.
sample.es: Cada una de 4 plantas necesita 3/8 de galón de agua. 4 × 3/8 = 12/8 = 1 4/8 = 1 1/2 galones.

hints.en: Pick a setting with 4 equal amounts.
4 × 3 eighths is how many eighths?
12/8 is more than 1 whole.

objective: Find two numbers that satisfy a sum and a difference condition.

stem.en: Find two numbers whose sum is 10,000 and whose difference is 2,000. Show how you know your numbers work.
stem.es: Halla dos números cuya suma sea 10,000 y cuya diferencia sea 2,000. Muestra cómo sabes que tus números sirven.

sample.en: 6,000 and 4,000: 6,000 + 4,000 = 10,000 and 6,000 − 4,000 = 2,000. I started from 5,000 + 5,000 and moved 1,000 from one number to the other.

hints.en: Start with two equal numbers that add to 10,000.
Move some amount from one to the other.
Check both the sum and the difference.

objective: Use fractional line plot data to find the space left in a container.

stem.en: A line plot shows 6 pours of water in liters: 1/2, 1/2, 3/4, 3/4, 3/4 and 1. All of the water goes into a 5-liter tank. How many liters of space are left in the tank?
stem.es: Una gráfica de puntos muestra 6 vertidos de agua en litros: 1/2, 1/2, 3/4, 3/4, 3/4 y 1. Toda el agua se vierte en un tanque de 5 litros. ¿Cuántos litros de espacio quedan en el tanque?

sample.en: In fourths: 2/4 + 2/4 + 9/4 + 4/4 = 17/4 = 4 1/4 liters. 5 − 4 1/4 = 3/4 liter of space left.
sample.es: En cuartos: 2/4 + 2/4 + 9/4 + 4/4 = 17/4 = 4 1/4 litros. 5 − 4 1/4 = 3/4 de litro de espacio.

hints.en: Count each X as one pour.
Add all six pours using fourths.
Subtract the total from 5.

objective: Compare two number patterns and find when one first exceeds the other.

stem.en: Pattern A starts at 5 and adds 6 each time. Pattern B starts at 20 and adds 3 each time. Find the first term where Pattern A is greater than Pattern B. Show your work in a table or list.
stem.es: El patrón A empieza en 5 y suma 6 cada vez. El patrón B empieza en 20 y suma 3 cada vez. Halla el primer término en el que el patrón A es mayor que el patrón B. Muestra tu trabajo en una tabla o lista.

criteria.es: Enumera los términos de ambos patrones

criteria.en: Notes the patterns are equal at term 6 (35 and 35)
criteria.es: Nota que los patrones son iguales en el término 6 (35 y 35)

stem.es: Crea un patrón numérico que empiece en 2 y multiplique por 3 cada vez. Escribe los primeros cinco números y di qué le pasa a cada número.

criteria.en: Describes multiplying the last term by 3
criteria.es: Describe multiplicar el término anterior por 3

sample.en: 2, 6, 18, 54, 162. Each number is 3 times the one before it.
sample.es: 2, 6, 18, 54, 162. Cada número es 3 veces el anterior.

hints.en: Start with 2.
Multiply 2 by 3 to get the next term.
Repeat with each new number.

solution.es: 2, 6, 18, 54, 162: cada término es el anterior multiplicado por 3.

objective: Extend a number pattern that follows an add rule to a later term.

stem.en: A pattern starts at 5 and the rule is add 3. What is the 8th number in the pattern?
stem.es: Un patrón empieza en 5 y la regla es sumar 3. ¿Cuál es el 8.º número del patrón?

hints.en: The first number is 5. The 8th number needs 7 more steps.
Each step adds the same amount.
Seven steps of 3 is how much?

steps: From the 1st to the 8th number there are 7 steps of 3.

objective: Identify the rule of a number pattern.

stem.en: What is the rule for this pattern? 3, 11, 19, 27, 35
stem.es: ¿Cuál es la regla de este patrón? 3, 11, 19, 27, 35

choices.why: 3 is the first number, not the amount that changes.
Only the first jump is from 3 to 11; the rule must work for every jump.

hints.en: Find the difference between neighbors.
Subtract 3 from 11, then 11 from 19.
Check that the same amount works for every pair.

solution.es: Cada número es 8 más que el anterior: regla sumar 8.

objective: Write an expression for the nth term of a pattern that adds a constant amount.

stem.en: A pattern starts with 3 and adds 5 each time: 3, 8, 13, 18. Write an expression for the nth term (term n).
stem.es: Un patrón empieza con 3 y suma 5 cada vez: 3, 8, 13, 18. Escribe una expresión para el término n.

hints.en: Term 1 is 3. Term 2 is 3 + one 5. Term 3 is 3 + two 5s.
How many 5s are added to get term n?
Compare your expression by testing n = 1, 2 and 3.

objective: Explain a feature of a pattern that is not stated in its rule.

stem.en: The pattern 1, 4, 7, 10, 13 follows the rule add 3. Explain why the terms switch between odd and even.
stem.es: El patrón 1, 4, 7, 10, 13 sigue la regla sumar 3. Explica por qué los términos cambian entre impar y par.

criteria.en: Notes that 3 is an odd number
criteria.es: Nota que 3 es un número impar

criteria.en: Explains odd + odd = even and even + odd = odd
criteria.es: Explica que impar + impar = par y par + impar = impar

sample.en: Each step adds 3, an odd number. Adding an odd number changes odd to even and even to odd: 1 + 3 = 4 and 4 + 3 = 7.
sample.es: Cada paso suma 3, un número impar. Sumar un impar cambia impar a par y par a impar: 1 + 3 = 4 y 4 + 3 = 7.

hints.en: Is 3 odd or even?
Try 1 + 3 and then 4 + 3.
What happens to a number's oddness when you add an odd number?

solution.es: Sumar 3, que es impar, cambia impar a par y par a impar.

objective: Plot term number and value for a pattern that adds the same amount each time.

stem.en: A pattern starts at 2 and adds 3 each time. Plot the first four terms. Use x for the term number (1, 2, 3, 4) and y for the value.
stem.es: Un patrón empieza en 2 y suma 3 cada vez. Marca los primeros cuatro términos. Usa x para el número del término (1, 2, 3, 4) y y para el valor.

hints.en: Term 1 is 2. Keep adding 3 for each next term.
Write the values: 2, then 2 + 3, and so on.
Plot (1, 2), then move right 1 and up 3 each time.

objective: Use a pattern rule to find a total over several weeks.

stem.en: Mia saves $5 in week 1. Each week after that she saves $3 more than the week before. How many dollars does she save in the first 6 weeks altogether?
stem.es: Mia ahorra $5 la semana 1. Cada semana siguiente ahorra $3 más que la semana anterior. ¿Cuántos dólares ahorra en total en las primeras 6 semanas?

hints.en: Write what she saves each week as a pattern.
The weekly amounts go up by 3.
Add up the six weekly amounts.

objective: Find the first term in a pattern that breaks the stated rule.

stem.en: The rule is add 6, starting at 6. Zoe wrote the steps. Which step has the mistake?
stem.es: La regla es sumar 6, empezando en 6. Zoe escribió los pasos. ¿Qué paso tiene el error?

hints.en: Check each addition one at a time.
Redo 18 + 6.
The error carries into every later term.

steps: The next terms should be 24 and 30.

objective: Sort digit comparisons by how many times greater one value is than the other.

stem.en: Sort each comparison by how many times as much the first value is as the second.
stem.es: Clasifica cada comparación según cuántas veces el primer valor es el segundo.

hints.en: Write the value of each digit first.
Divide the larger value by the smaller.
Count how many places apart the digits are.

solution.es: Un lugar de diferencia es 10 veces; dos lugares es 100 veces.

objective: Compare the values of the same digit in neighboring places.

stem.en: In the number 4,400, the first 4 is in the thousands place and the second 4 is in the hundreds place. The first 4 is worth how many times the second 4?
stem.es: En el número 4,400, el primer 4 está en el lugar de los millares y el segundo 4 está en el lugar de las centenas. ¿Cuántas veces vale el primer 4 el valor del segundo 4?

hints.en: Write the value of each 4: one is 4,000 and one is 400.
Compare the two values by dividing.
How many 400s make 4,000?

steps: The first 4 is worth 4,000 and the second is worth 400.

objective: Compare the values of the same digit two places apart.

stem.en: In 636,000, how many times as much is the value of the first 6 as the value of the last 6?
stem.es: En 636,000, ¿cuántas veces es el valor del primer 6 con respecto al valor del último 6?

choices.why: 10 times is one place apart. The first 6 and last 6 are two places apart: 600,000 and 6,000.
That would be three places apart.
Dividing the digits 6 ÷ 6 gives 1; compare the values instead.

hints.en: Find the value of each 6 using its place.
The first 6 is 600,000; the last 6 is worth 6,000.

steps: The first 6 is worth 100 times the last 6.

objective: Identify the place where a digit's value is one-tenth of another.

stem.en: A digit 7 is in the ten-thousands place of 70,000. In which number is 7 worth one-tenth as much as in 70,000?
stem.es: Un dígito 7 está en el lugar de las decenas de millar de 70,000. ¿En qué número el 7 vale la décima parte que en 70,000?

choices.why: In 700,000 the 7 is worth 10 times as much, not one-tenth.
700 is one-hundredth of 70,000.
70 is one-thousandth of 70,000.

hints.en: One-tenth means divide the value by 10.
Think about which place is one place to the right.
Compare 7 ten-thousands with 7 thousands.

steps: The 7 in 7,000 is worth one-tenth of the 7 in 70,000.

objective: Use the ten-times relationship across places in a context.

stem.en: A bag holds 300 beads. A crate holds 10 bags. A pallet holds 10 crates. How many beads are on one pallet?
stem.es: Una bolsa tiene 300 cuentas. Una caja tiene 10 bolsas. Una paleta tiene 10 cajas. ¿Cuántas cuentas hay en una paleta?

criteria.es: Halla las cuentas en una caja: 3,000
Halla las cuentas en una paleta: 30,000

sample.en: A crate has 300 × 10 = 3,000 beads. A pallet has 3,000 × 10 = 30,000 beads.
sample.es: Una caja tiene 300 × 10 = 3,000 cuentas. Una paleta tiene 3,000 × 10 = 30,000 cuentas.

hints.en: Each step multiplies by 10.
Find the beads in one crate first.
Then find the beads in 10 crates.

objective: Find the error when comparing the values of two digits in a number.

stem.en: Ben compared the 3s in 3,300. Which step has the mistake?
stem.es: Ben comparó los 3 en 3,300. ¿Qué paso tiene el error?

hints.en: Count how many places apart the two 3s are.
Divide the larger value by the smaller one.
Does 300 × 100 equal 3,000?

steps: The 3s are one place apart, so it is 10 times, not 100 times.
The first 3 is worth 3,000 and the second is worth 300.

objective: Explain why a digit is worth ten times as much in the place to its left.

stem.en: Explain why the 6 in 60,000 is worth ten times as much as the 6 in 6,000.
stem.es: Explica por qué el 6 en 60,000 vale diez veces más que el 6 en 6,000.

criteria.en: Explains each place is ten times the one to its right
criteria.es: Explica que cada lugar vale diez veces el de su derecha

sample.en: The 6 in 60,000 is worth 60,000 and the 6 in 6,000 is worth 6,000. 6,000 × 10 = 60,000. Each place to the left is worth ten times as much as the place to its right.
sample.es: El 6 en 60,000 vale 60,000 y el 6 en 6,000 vale 6,000. 6,000 × 10 = 60,000. Cada lugar a la izquierda vale diez veces el lugar a su derecha.

hints.en: Write the value of each 6.
Which place is farther left, ten-thousands or thousands?
Use multiplication by 10.

steps: 60,000 and 6,000 differ by a factor of 10.
The place to the left is worth ten times as much.
solution.es: Cada lugar vale 10 veces el lugar de su derecha: 6,000 × 10 = 60,000.

objective: Match digits to values that are ten times or one-tenth of the given digit value.

stem.en: Match each description to the correct value.
stem.es: Relaciona cada descripción con el valor correcto.

hints.en: Ten times moves a digit one place to the left.
One-tenth moves a digit one place to the right.
Start from the full value of the digit.

solution.es: Diez veces mueve el dígito un lugar a la izquierda y una décima parte un lugar a la derecha.

objective: Draw an angle with a given whole-number measure.

stem.en: Use the angle tool to open the angle to 125 degrees.
stem.es: Usa la herramienta de ángulos para abrir el ángulo a 125 grados.

hints.en: 125 is more than a right angle.
Open the angle until the reading is 125°.
An angle between 90° and 180° is called obtuse.

objective: Choose the correct protractor scale by checking whether the angle is acute or obtuse.

stem.en: An angle looks smaller than a right angle. One ray is on the 0° mark of the outer scale. The other ray points to both 40° and 140° on the two scales. What is the measure of the angle?
stem.es: Un ángulo parece menor que un ángulo recto. Un rayo está en la marca 0° de la escala exterior. El otro rayo señala 40° y 140° en las dos escalas. ¿Cuánto mide el ángulo?

choices.why: An angle smaller than a right angle must be less than 90°.
90° is a right angle, but the rays show 40° and 140°.
180° is a straight line.

hints.en: A right angle is 90°.
Is the angle smaller or larger than 90°?
Choose the reading that fits.

steps: The angle is acute, so it is less than 90°.
solution.es: El ángulo es agudo, así que mide 40°.

objective: Measure an angle when neither ray is on zero on a protractor.

stem.en: On a protractor, one ray of an angle passes through the 20° mark and the other ray passes through the 85° mark on the same scale. What is the measure of the angle?
stem.es: En un transportador, un rayo de un ángulo pasa por la marca de 20° y el otro rayo pasa por la marca de 85° en la misma escala. ¿Cuánto mide el ángulo?

hints.en: The angle is the opening between the two rays.
Both marks are on the same scale.
Subtract the smaller reading from the larger.

objective: Find the missing part of a right angle.

stem.en: A right angle is split into two angles. One angle measures 28°. What does the other angle measure?
stem.es: Un ángulo recto se divide en dos ángulos. Uno de los ángulos mide 28°. ¿Cuánto mide el otro ángulo?

hints.en: A right angle is 90°.
The two parts add up to 90°.
Subtract 28 from 90.

objective: Relate a turn on a clock to an angle measure.

stem.en: A minute hand moves from the 12 to the 3 on a clock. How many degrees does it turn?
stem.es: La manecilla de los minutos se mueve del 12 al 3 en un reloj. ¿Cuántos grados gira?

choices.why: 30° is the turn from one number to the next number.
45° is one eighth of a full turn.
180° is the turn from the 12 to the 6.

hints.en: A full turn around the clock is 360°.
The 3 is one quarter of the way around.
Find 1/4 of 360.

solution.es: De las 12 a las 3 es un cuarto de vuelta: 90°.

objective: Compare two fractions with the same numerator.

stem.en: Which fraction is greater?
stem.es: ¿Cuál fracción es mayor?

choices.why: Eighths are smaller pieces than fifths, so 3 eighths is less than 3 fifths.
The pieces are different sizes, so 3 fifths and 3 eighths are not the same amount.

hints.en: Both fractions have 3 parts.
Which pieces are bigger, fifths or eighths?
Fewer parts in the whole means bigger parts.

solution.es: Los quintos son más grandes que los octavos.

objective: Find the least of several decimals.

stem.en: Which decimal is the least?
stem.es: ¿Cuál decimal es el menor?

choices.why: 0.8 is 80 hundredths, much more than 8 hundredths.
0.18 is 18 hundredths.
0.81 is 81 hundredths.

hints.en: Write each decimal in hundredths.
Which number of hundredths is smallest?

objective: Subtract two four-digit numbers.

stem.en: A lake has 9,420 fish. After a flood, 5,280 fish swim away. How many fish are left?
stem.es: Un lago tiene 9,420 peces. Después de una inundación, 5,280 peces se van nadando. ¿Cuántos peces quedan?

hints.en: Subtract the number that swam away.
Subtract place by place.
Regroup if a top digit is too small.

objective: Divide a three-digit number by a one-digit number.

stem.en: A school has 648 students. They form 3 equal lines. How many students are in each line?
stem.es: Una escuela tiene 648 estudiantes. Forman 3 filas iguales. ¿Cuántos estudiantes hay en cada fila?

hints.en: Share 648 equally into 3 lines.
Split 648 into 600 + 48.
Divide each part by 3.

objective: Divide a two-digit number by a one-digit number.

stem.en: A gardener plants 84 flowers in 6 equal rows. How many flowers are in each row?
stem.es: Un jardinero planta 84 flores en 6 filas iguales. ¿Cuántas flores hay en cada fila?

hints.en: Equal rows mean division.
6 × 10 = 60. How many are left?

objective: Find the numerator of an equivalent fraction.

stem.en: Mina cuts a sandwich into 10 equal pieces. She eats the same amount as 1/2 of the sandwich. How many of the 10 pieces does she eat?
stem.es: Mina corta un sándwich en 10 partes iguales. Come la misma cantidad que 1/2 del sándwich. ¿Cuántas de las 10 partes come?

hints.en: How many tenths make one half?
Multiply the denominator 2 by 5 to get 10.
Do the same to the numerator.

objective: Estimate a product by rounding a three-digit factor.

stem.en: About how much is 4 × 312?
stem.es: ¿Aproximadamente cuánto es 4 × 312?

choices.why: This is 4 × 30. 312 is about 300, not 30.
This is 4 × 3,000. 312 is about 300.
This adds 4 + 312 and rounds.

hints.en: Round 312 to a friendly number.
312 is close to 300.
4 × 300 is 4 × 3 hundreds.

objective: Identify a factor of a whole number.

stem.en: Which number is a factor of 36?
stem.es: ¿Qué número es un factor de 36?

choices.why: 36 is not in the count-by-5 pattern, so 5 does not divide 36.
7 × 5 = 35 and 7 × 6 = 42. 36 is between them.
10 × 3 = 30 and 10 × 4 = 40, so 36 is not a multiple of 10.

hints.en: A factor divides the number with nothing left over.
Think of multiplication facts that make 36.
Test each choice by skip counting.

solution.es: 9 × 4 = 36, así que 9 es un factor de 36.

objective: Match factor pairs to their products.

stem.en: Match each factor pair to its product.
stem.es: Relaciona cada par de factores con su producto.

hints.en: Multiply the two factors.
Skip count if you need to.
Use facts you know.

objective: Multiply to find a quantity that is several times as many.

stem.en: A small ferry carries 8 cars. A big ferry carries 5 times as many cars. How many cars does the big ferry carry?
stem.es: Un transbordador pequeño lleva 8 autos. Un transbordador grande lleva 5 veces tantos autos. ¿Cuántos autos lleva el transbordador grande?

hints.en: Draw 5 equal groups of 8.
Times as many means multiply.
Count by 8s five times.

objective: Subtract fractions with the same denominator.

stem.en: A ribbon is 7/10 meter long. Mia cuts off 4/10 meter. How long is the ribbon now?
stem.es: Una cinta mide 7/10 de metro de largo. Mia corta 4/10 de metro. ¿Cuánto mide ahora la cinta?

hints.en: Both lengths are in tenths.
Subtract the numerators.
Keep the denominator.

objective: Add fractions with the same denominator.

stem.en: Ben used 2/9 of a bottle of glue on Monday and 5/9 of the bottle on Tuesday. What fraction of the bottle did he use?
stem.es: Ben usó 2/9 de un frasco de pegamento el lunes y 5/9 del frasco el martes. ¿Qué fracción del frasco usó?

hints.en: The pieces are ninths.
Count the ninths used each day.
Add the numerators.

objective: Multiply a whole number by a unit fraction.

stem.en: Each pizza slice is 1/5 of a pizza. Zoe eats 4 slices. What fraction of a pizza does Zoe eat?
stem.es: Cada rebanada de pizza es 1/5 de una pizza. Zoe come 4 rebanadas. ¿Qué fracción de una pizza come Zoe?

hints.en: Four slices of 1/5.
Count the fifths.
Add 1/5 four times.

objective: Use a line of symmetry to find a whole measurement from half.

stem.en: A paper heart is symmetric about a line down its middle. The left half is 9 centimeters wide. How wide is the whole heart in centimeters?
stem.es: Un corazón de papel es simétrico respecto a una línea en el medio. La mitad izquierda mide 9 centímetros de ancho. ¿Cuántos centímetros de ancho mide el corazón completo?

hints.en: The right half is the mirror image of the left half.
Both halves have the same width.
Add the two halves.

objective: Convert kilograms to grams.

stem.en: A bag of rice has a mass of 5 kilograms. What is its mass in grams?
stem.es: Una bolsa de arroz tiene una masa de 5 kilogramos. ¿Cuál es su masa en gramos?

hints.en: 1 kilogram is 1,000 grams.
Five kilograms is five groups of 1,000 grams.
Multiply by 1,000.

objective: Compare several multi-digit numbers to find the least.

stem.en: Which of these numbers is the smallest?
stem.es: ¿Cuál de estos números es el menor?

choices.why: Compare the hundreds: 9 is greater than 8.
The thousands digit 9 is greater than 6.
The thousands digit 9 is greater than 6.

hints.en: Compare the thousands place first.
Two numbers have 6 thousands. Compare those two.
Then compare hundreds.

steps: 8 hundreds is less than 9 hundreds, so 56,890 is least.

objective: Count the data values on a line plot.

stem.en: A line plot has 2 X marks above 1/4, 3 X marks above 1/2 and 1 X mark above 3/4. How many data values does it show?
stem.es: Una gráfica de puntos tiene 2 marcas X sobre 1/4, 3 marcas X sobre 1/2 y 1 marca X sobre 3/4. ¿Cuántos datos muestra?

choices.why: This counts the number of different measurements, not the number of X marks.
This adds the fractions. Each X is one data value.
This counts only the X marks above 1/4.

hints.en: Each X is one data value.
Count the X marks above every measurement.
Add the numbers of X marks.

objective: Solve a two-step problem with multiplication and addition.

stem.en: Max has 50 marbles. He buys 2 bags with 12 marbles in each bag. How many marbles does Max have now?
stem.es: Max tiene 50 canicas. Compra 2 bolsas con 12 canicas en cada bolsa. ¿Cuántas canicas tiene Max ahora?

hints.en: First find the marbles in the new bags.
Then add them to the marbles he already had.
2 bags of 12 is 24.

objective: Plot the reflection of a point across a vertical line.

stem.en: The line x = 6 is a line of symmetry. A point is at (4, 2). Plot its mirror image.
stem.es: La línea x = 6 es una línea de simetría. Un punto está en (4, 2). Marca su imagen reflejada.

hints.en: How many units is the point from the line?
The mirror image is the same distance on the other side.
The height does not change.

steps: The mirror point is 2 units right: (8, 2).
solution.es: La imagen está 2 unidades a la derecha de x = 6: (8, 2).

objective: Multiply a three-digit number with a zero by a one-digit number.

stem.en: A box holds 409 paper clips. How many paper clips are in 8 boxes?
stem.es: Una caja tiene 409 sujetapapeles. ¿Cuántos sujetapapeles hay en 8 cajas?

hints.en: Break 409 into 400 + 9.
Multiply 8 by each part.
Add the two products.

objective: Continue a pattern that multiplies by the same number.

stem.en: What number comes next in this pattern? 2, 4, 8, 16, ___
stem.es: ¿Qué número sigue en este patrón? 2, 4, 8, 16, ___

choices.why: This adds 4 each time, but the earlier jumps were 2, 4 and 8.
This adds 8, but the jumps are not the same size.
This adds 2. Look at how each number compares with the last.

hints.en: Compare each number with the one before it.
2 to 4, 4 to 8, 8 to 16: how does the number change?
Apply the same change to 16.

steps: Each number is twice the number before it.
solution.es: Cada número es el doble del anterior: 16 × 2 = 32.

objective: Extend a number pattern by one term using its rule.

stem.en: The pattern 7, 11, 15, ___ follows the rule add 4. What number goes in the blank?
stem.es: El patrón 7, 11, 15, ___ sigue la regla sumar 4. ¿Qué número va en el espacio?

hints.en: Look at the last number shown.
Apply the rule once more.
Add the rule number.

objective: Plot the terms of a simple pattern as ordered pairs.

stem.en: Zoe saves $4 each week. Plot her total savings after week 1, week 2 and week 3. Use x for the week number and y for the total dollars.
stem.es: Zoe ahorra $4 cada semana. Marca sus ahorros totales después de la semana 1, la semana 2 y la semana 3. Usa x para el número de la semana y y para el total de dólares.

hints.en: Term 1 is 4.
Each term is 4 more than the one before.
Write each point as (term number, value).

objective: Find the perimeter of a small rectangle.

stem.en: A photo is 5 inches long and 3 inches wide. What is the perimeter of the photo in inches?
stem.es: Una foto mide 5 pulgadas de largo y 3 pulgadas de ancho. ¿Cuál es el perímetro de la foto en pulgadas?

hints.en: Perimeter is the distance around.
Or double the sum 5 + 3.

objective: Name lines that meet to form a right angle.

stem.en: Two lines cross and form a right angle. What are the lines called?
stem.es: Dos rectas se cruzan y forman un ángulo recto. ¿Cómo se llaman las rectas?

choices.why: Parallel lines never cross.
Acute describes an angle, not a pair of lines.
Rays are parts of lines that start at a point.

hints.en: Think about the corner of a window.
Which lines meet to make a square corner?
Parallel lines do not meet.

steps: Lines that cross at a right angle are perpendicular.
solution.es: Las rectas que forman un ángulo recto son perpendiculares.

verify.note: Naming perpendicular lines is a vocabulary check.

objective: Compare the values of one digit in neighboring places.

stem.en: In the number 5,500, the first 5 is worth how many times the second 5?
stem.es: En el número 5,500, ¿cuántas veces vale el primer 5 con respecto al segundo 5?

choices.why: 5 is the digit. Compare the values, 5,000 and 500.
That would be two places apart.
That would be two places apart.

hints.en: Write the value of each 5.
Divide the larger value by the smaller.

steps: The first 5 is 5,000 and the second 5 is 500.

objective: Measure an angle between two protractor readings.

stem.en: The rays of an angle point to 15° and 60° on the same protractor scale. What is the measure of the angle?
stem.es: Los rayos de un ángulo señalan 15° y 60° en la misma escala del transportador. ¿Cuánto mide el ángulo?

hints.en: Find the opening between the two readings.
Subtract the smaller reading from the larger.
60 minus 15.

objective: Identify the measure of a right angle.

stem.en: Which angle measure is a right angle?
stem.es: ¿Cuál medida de ángulo es un ángulo recto?

choices.why: 45° is an acute angle, smaller than a right angle.
120° is an obtuse angle, greater than a right angle.
180° is a straight angle.

hints.en: A right angle looks like the corner of a sheet of paper.
It is a quarter of a full turn.
Half a straight angle is a right angle.

objective: Round a four-digit number to the nearest thousand.

stem.en: A library has 5,372 books. What is that number rounded to the nearest thousand?
stem.es: Una biblioteca tiene 5,372 libros. ¿Cuánto es ese número redondeado al millar más cercano?

hints.en: Find the thousands digit.
Look at the hundreds digit.
Is it less than 5 or 5 or more?

steps: The hundreds digit is 3, less than 5.
solution.es: El dígito de las centenas es 3, así que se redondea a 5,000.

objective: Round a number whose lower digits are large, using only the digit to the right.

stem.en: A city has 82,499 people. What is that rounded to the nearest ten thousand?
stem.es: Una ciudad tiene 82,499 personas. ¿Cuánto es eso redondeado a la decena de millar más cercana?

choices.why: The thousands digit is 2, so do not round up.
That rounds to the nearest thousand.
That rounds to the nearest hundred.

hints.en: Find the ten-thousands digit.
Look only at the thousands digit next to it.
2 is less than 5.

solution.es: El dígito de los millares es 2, así que queda 80,000.

objective: Sort numbers by the ten they round to.

stem.en: Sort each number by the nearest ten it rounds to.
stem.es: Clasifica cada número según la decena más cercana a la que se redondea.

hints.en: Look at the ones digit.
0 to 4 round down.
5 to 9 round up.
